description: Audits the live page for defects that exist only once it has rendered, and that reading the source cannot find: a control with something painted over it, text cut off by its own container, a page that scrolls sideways, a webfont that never arrived, images with no reserved space, and text too small to read. Use it after a layout change, at a width you do not normally look at, or when a user says a button "does nothing" and the code looks fine. The covered-control check answers that one directly: it asks what a click at the button would actually hit.
name: audit_page
title: Problems only a rendered page has
